# May Tinh LMC - Cua hang may tinh chinh hang tai Hai Duong
> LMC la cua hang may tinh va linh kien may tinh chinh hang tai Hai Duong, Viet Nam.
> Dia chi: So 472 Dai Lo Le Thanh Nghi, Hai Duong. Hotline: 0220 660 6666.
> Kinh doanh: Man hinh, CPU, RAM, SSD, mainboard, VGA, tan nhiet, ban phim, chuot, tai nghe.
> Bao hanh: 12-36 thang chinh hang. Mo cua: Thu 2-7 tu 8h-21h, Chu nhat 9h-20h.

## Danh muc san pham chinh
- [Man hinh may tinh](https://maytinhlmc.vn/man-hinh-may-tinh): Man hinh gaming, van phong, do hoa tu MSI, ViewSonic, Samsung, LG. Gia tu 2.5-30 trieu.
- [O cung SSD](https://maytinhlmc.vn/o-cung-ssd): SSD NVMe PCIe 4.0/5.0, SATA tu Samsung, WD, Kingston, Crucial. Gia tu 500k-5 trieu.
- [Mainboard](https://maytinhlmc.vn/bo-mach-chu): Bo mach chu Intel/AMD tu MSI, ASUS, Gigabyte. Gia tu 1.5-15 trieu.
- [RAM may tinh](https://maytinhlmc.vn/ram-may-tinh): DDR4, DDR5 tu Kingston, Corsair, G.Skill. Gia tu 400k-5 trieu.
- [Tan nhiet](https://maytinhlmc.vn/tan-nhiet): Tan nhiet khi va nuoc AIO tu DeepCool, NZXT, ASUS ROG.
- [Loa, tai nghe, mic](https://maytinhlmc.vn/loa-tai-nghe-mic-webcam): Thiet bi am thanh tu Logitech, Razer, HyperX.
- [Ban phim, chuot, ban ghe](https://maytinhlmc.vn/phim-chuot-ban-ghe-gear): Gear gaming tu Logitech, Razer, Edra.

## Dich vu
- Lap rap PC theo yeu cau (Build PC tool): https://maytinhlmc.vn/pc-builder
- Tu van cau hinh mien phi
- Bao hanh, sua chua
- Giao hang toan quoc

## Thong tin cua hang
- Ten: May Tinh LMC (LMC)
- Dia chi: So 472 Dai Lo Le Thanh Nghi, Hai Duong, Viet Nam
- Tinh/thanh: Hai Duong
- Hotline kinh doanh: 0220 660 6666
- Ho tro khach hang: 0985 633 455
- Gio mo cua: Thu 2-7: 8:00-21:00, Chu nhat: 9:00-20:00
- Website: https://maytinhlmc.vn
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/maytinhlmc
- Da dang ky voi Bo Cong Thuong Viet Nam

## Cac thuong hieu chinh hang dang phan phoi
MSI, ASUS, Gigabyte, ViewSonic, Samsung, LG, Kingston, Corsair, WD, Seagate, Crucial, DeepCool, NZXT, Logitech, Razer, HyperX, Edra
